meta_description: Three starter prompts to try Claude's Projects, Connectors, and Artifacts with your own business: answer customer questions, prep your week, and build a shareable checklist.
sub: One for Projects, one for Connectors, one for Artifacts. Start at claude.ai.
intro: Here are my 3 starter prompts for Claude.

steps.title: Projects
steps.text: Create a project called [Your business]. Upload your offer, pricing and FAQs. Then ask:
steps.prompt: Using these files, write 5 answers to the questions my customers ask most.

steps.title: Connectors
steps.text: Go to Settings > Connectors and connect Google Drive, Calendar or HubSpot. Then ask:
steps.prompt: What's on my calendar this week and what do I need to prep?

steps.title: Artifacts
steps.prompt: Build me a client onboarding checklist for [your business] as an interactive checklist I can share with my team.
